verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. The pack shows no open-source release of Adyen's in-person payments product. The only GitHub evidence is a repository of OpenAPI API definition files, which describes the API rather than containing the product's source, and no license is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
